column1: **cellpert_nts:** Number of time steps after which perturbations are seeded
**cellpert_sw2b:** Only south and west bnds perturbed (for idealized cases): 0=off; 1=south & west; 2=south *C-O if cellpertSelector > 0*
**cellpert_amp:** Maximum amplitude for the potential temperature perturbations *C-O if cellpertSelector > 0*
**cellpert_gppc:** Number of grid points conforming the cell *C-O if cellpertSelector > 0*
**cellpert_ndbc:** Number of cells normal to domain lateral boundaries *C-O if cellpertSelector > 0*
**cellpert_kbottom:** Z-grid point where the perturbations start *C-O if cellpertSelector > 0*
**cellpert_ktop:** Z-grid point where the perturbations end *C-O if cellpertSelector > 0*
**cellpert_tvcp:** Time-varying CP method selector: 0=off; 1=on (hydroBCs==1) *C-O if cellpertSelector > 0*
**cellpert_eckert:** Eckert number for the potential temperature perturbations (hydroBCs==1) *C-O if cellpertSelector > 0*
**cellpert_tsfact:** Factor on the refreshing perturbation time scale (hydroBCs==1) *C-O if cellpertSelector > 0*
